flags.missing: Gas-smell steps: the urgency of "Immediately call your gas supplier from a neighbor's phone" (keep "immediately" or "right away", and where to call from).
Lighting label: "If you still smell gas, STOP! Follow B in the safety information above" after the wait before retrying.
Gas control: the consequence "Force or attempted repair may result in a fire or explosion."
Under water: "Immediately call a qualified service technician to inspect the appliance and to replace any part of the control system and any gas control which has been under water."

A short summary (fault line or search hint) says to wait and retry/relight without the stop condition. If the manual's relight instruction includes the gas-smell check, add "if you still smell gas, stop" to the summary; if it doesn't, leave it.
flags.where: index_extra: Wait 5 minutes, retry, then call for service
